WP7: D26a: Magnus T&C (revision effective 20 Jun 2025): 12 EDGE REWARD Points per Rs200 up to Rs1.5 lakh of monthly spend, 35 per Rs200 above it. The record stated 12 after the limit. Worked examples 006 and 007.
WP7: D26a: the post-limit rate (35 per Rs200) is above the in-cap rate (12), as the issuer states; the cited flag lets the loader emit it as custom_rate.
changes.citation: You will earn 35 EDGE REWARD Points per INR 200 on spends^ above INR 1.5 lakhs

changes.reason: Revision eff. 20 Jun 2025: 35 per INR 200 above INR 1.5 lakh "up to spends equivalent to your credit limit + additional INR 1.5 Lakhs per calendar month. Thereafter, you will earn 12". The 35 band itself is carried by base_150k_spend (custom post-limit 35, D26a); its upper bound depends on the cardholder's credit limit (D13).
Ceiling = assigned credit limit + INR 1.5 lakh per calendar month (revision eff. 20 Jun 2025): user-dependent cap (D13a), amount null.

Accelerated 35 T&C example row 4: Travel EDGE Rs 2,10,000 earns 12 EP/Rs.200 base, and only the spend above Rs 2 lakh is "Considered in eligible spends" for the 23-point accelerated top-up, which needs monthly eligible spend above Rs 1.5 lakh. Paying 35 above Rs 2 lakh unconditionally over-states; 12 (base) is paid and the conditional top-up is not modelled (H2).

Same T&C: Travel EDGE spend above Rs 2 lakh is ordinary eligible spend (12 base, plus 23 only through the monthly accelerated calculation), not a flat 35. The travel_edge_200k_spend post-limit (12) carries it; this info row stated 35 unconditionally.

Education is not in the Magnus exclusion list (revision eff. 20 Jun 2025: Utility & Telecom, Rent, Wallet, Government, Insurance, Gold & Jewellery, Fuel, Cash advances, Repayments; 35 T&C point 3). The conditions were commentary (direct vs third-party fee) that made the rule info; it earns the base 12 per Rs 200 under base_150k_spend, like any eligible spend.

action.reason: Grab Deals spends earn the base 12 EDGE Reward Points per Rs 200 and do not count toward the Rs 1.5 lakh accelerated threshold.

changes.reason: Accelerated 35 T&C example row 6 and note 2: Grab Deals/GYFTR earn "12 EP/Rs.200" with "no AEP", and "spends on Grab Deals, GYFTR will not be calculated for Total Eligible Spends". Without this row a Grab Deals spend counted toward base_150k_spend and could unlock 35 per Rs 200 early (over-statement). The 'up to 5X' Grab Deals bonus is not modelled (H2).
